visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man wearing a white swim cap and black trunks stands in the center of an infinity pool. He flexes his chest and abdomen muscles while looking directly at the camera with a confident expression. The setting features a clear, bright blue sky and a transparent glass barrier at the pool's edge. (2) The scene cuts to a medium close-up of the man sitting on the pool deck. He wears sunglasses and talks towards the camera, gesturing with his hands joined together. Behind him, a tall modern glass skyscraper, several closed patio umbrellas, and a lifeguard tower are visible under bright daylight. (3) The man leans forward and dives into the water, creating a white splash. He swims toward the far side of the pool. A lifeguard in a red shirt is seated on a high chair in the background, near small trees in planters. (4) The camera captures a close-up of the man swimming towards the lens. He wears goggles and his mouth is open as he takes a breath. He reaches the pool's edge and pulls himself up with his arms, displaying water dripping from his shoulders and chest. (5) Standing on the dry deck, he performs a series of bodybuilding poses. He turns his back to the camera to flex his latissimus dorsi and biceps, then rotates to show his side and front muscles with hands on hips. (6) He squats at the edge of the pool, waves his right hand in a goodbye gesture, and then dives back into the water with a smooth motion.
